title: Unstructured and very thin material. Best for light items
text: Unstructured and very thin material. Best for light items. If you're getting these for less than two bucks each, then they are decent bags. A penny more than that and they are overpriced. This is thin material and floppy with no internal structure of any sort. They won't stand up without being held so using them in a grocery store line is going be slower than it should be. There's also no bottom. I'm hesitant to use these for more than light weight items - snacks, frozen meals, toilet paper etc. I won't use them for canned goods or meats because I don't want to risk torn seams.
